svg.title: SafeOS Guardian — how it all works
svg.desc: A two-zone architecture diagram. The browser zone runs entirely on the user's device: camera and microphone feeds plus reference photos flow through a per-frame screening layer (pixel-diff motion detection, audio FFT, and pixel-change counting at roughly 5 to 10 Hz) that gates the four-model CV inference pipeline below (COCO-SSD via TensorFlow.js, ViT-base via Transformers.js, Web Audio FFT, and a perceptual color-plus-edge fingerprint). CV models only fire when the screening layer detects activity, keeping the GPU idle otherwise. Detections pass to a severity-tiered alert engine, with IndexedDB and a service worker providing local storage and caching. A second, opt-in zone below shows an optional API server fanning alerts out to Resend email, Twilio SMS, Telegram, an Ollama LAN install, or cloud LLM fallback.

g.text: STATIC PWA · RUNS ENTIRELY IN YOUR BROWSER · OFFLINE-READY
motion · pixel-diff · audio FFT · every frame (~5–10 Hz)
info · low · medium · high · critical — severity-tiered routing & escalation
YOUR INFRASTRUCTURE · ENABLES FAN-OUT CHANNELS & LLM BRIDGES
